skill.descEnRank5: Summon a Tambourinist that generates music notes for 5s. Each note collected by a party member increases ATK by 15.00%, recovers 10.00% HP, boosts Movement Speed by 20.00%, and rescovers 100 STA for them. It also increases their Basic Attack and Heavy Attack DMG to Immobilized targets by 150.00%. The effect lasts for 20s. Throughout the battle, all Resonators' ATK is increased by 1.00% for each music note collected. Cooldown: 30s.
